duty_voice_channels.label: Voice-channel duty
duty_voice_channels.description: Joining these voice channels clocks the member in (into the first type); leaving clocks them out

duty_max_hours.label: Longest shift
duty_max_hours.description: A shift can last at most this many hours, then the bot clocks the member out (time up to then counts)

duty_idle_minutes.label: Activity check
duty_idle_minutes.description: After this many minutes the bot asks in a DM whether the member is still on duty; without a reply it clocks them out

duty_idle_reply_minutes.label: Time to answer the check
duty_idle_reply_minutes.description: How long the member has to answer the check DM

duty_idle_remove_time.label: Discount unanswered time
duty_idle_remove_time.description: If the member didn't answer, the time since their last confirmation doesn't count

duty_sticky_channel.label: Live duty list
duty_sticky_channel.description: A live list of who is on duty — always kept at the bottom of the channel (moved at most once a minute)

duty_panel_title.label: Panel title
duty_panel_title.description: The title of the duty panel

duty_panel_text.label: Panel text
duty_panel_text.description: The text of the duty panel

duty_quotas.label: Quota roles
duty_quotas.description: A role after time served, one per line: role ID = minutes [= type] (also settable with a role picker via /duty quota)

duty_loa_enabled.label: Leave requests
duty_loa_enabled.description: Members can request leave of absence (LOA): /duty loa request, or with the button of the separate absence panel (on the web: Reports → Panels)

duty_loa_channel.label: Leave request channel
duty_loa_channel.description: Leave requests are posted here for review (with buttons)

duty_loa_reviewer_role.label: Leave reviewer role
duty_loa_reviewer_role.description: This role can also review leave requests (besides duty managers)

duty_loa_auto_approve.label: Auto-approve
duty_loa_auto_approve.description: Requests are approved instantly, without review

duty_loa_role.label: Leave role
duty_loa_role.description: Members get this role while on leave

duty_loa_clockout.label: Clock out during leave
duty_loa_clockout.description: During leave the member is clocked out of every duty and can't clock in

duty_loa_tag_nick.label: [LOA] in the nickname
duty_loa_tag_nick.description: “[LOA]” is added before the nickname during leave (needs Manage Nicknames)

duty_report_period.label: Report frequency
duty_report_period.description: Automatic report of duty time: off, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly

duty_report_channel.label: Report channel
duty_report_channel.description: Channel for reports (empty: the duty log)

duty_report_hour.label: Report time
duty_report_hour.description: At what hour the report is sent (local time)

duty_report_weekday.label: Weekly report day
duty_report_weekday.description: Day of the weekly report (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday)

duty_report_monthday.label: Monthly report day
duty_report_monthday.description: Day of the month for the monthly (and yearly) report

duty_report_output.label: Report format
duty_report_output.description: Report format: summary (card), csv (file) or both

duty_report_reset.label: Reset period after report
duty_report_reset.description: After the report the period counters are reset (all-time totals stay)

duty_report_full_export.label: Full export with report
duty_report_full_export.description: Also attach the all-time CSV to the report

duty_dm_summary.label: Summary on clock-out (DM)
duty_dm_summary.description: On clock-out the member gets a personal DM summary: time on duty (breaks excluded), today / week / month / all-time totals, rank this week, streak, weekly goal and pay

duty_weekly_goal_hours.label: Weekly goal
duty_weekly_goal_hours.description: Weekly goal in hours — personal stats, summaries and the weekly DM all show the progress

duty_hourly_wage.label: Hourly wage
duty_hourly_wage.description: Hourly wage in the server's currency: summaries, personal stats, reports and payslips also show the pay

duty_goal_reminder.label: Weekly goal reminder
duty_goal_reminder.description: On Thursday (at the report hour) a DM reminder to anyone far behind their weekly goal

duty_loa_cooldown_minutes.label: Wait after a denial
duty_loa_cooldown_minutes.description: After a denied request the member can't ask again for this long (a member can only have one pending or active leave at a time anyway)

duty_weekly_dm.label: Weekly summary (DM)
duty_weekly_dm.description: Personal weekly summary by DM on the weekly report day and hour: this week's time, change from last week, rank, weekly goal

duty_payslip_dm.label: Payslip (DM)
duty_payslip_dm.description: When a period is closed (reset, delete, report with reset) everyone affected gets their closed time and — with an hourly wage — their pay by DM

warn_expiry_days.label: Warning expiry
warn_expiry_days.description: After this many days a warning expires (expired ones don't count on the ladder)

warn_ladder.label: Warning ladder
warn_ladder.description: The warning ladder (1–10 levels): role and action (none, timeout, kick, ban) by the number of active warnings — editable on the web. Empty: the old threshold setting applies

warn_dm.label: DM about warnings
warn_dm.description: The member gets a DM on new, revoked and expired warnings (reason, active count, expiry)

duty_access_role.label: Duty access role
duty_access_role.description: If set, ONLY members with this role can clock in (panel, /szolgalat be, voice channel) — duty managers and admins always can. Anyone who loses it while on duty is clocked out

public_page.label: Public page
public_page.description: The server has a public page on the web (anyone can see it without logging in): name, icon, member count, description, invite

public_page_leaderboard.label: Leaderboard on the public page
public_page_leaderboard.description: The level and economy leaderboards are shown on the public page too

public_page_description.label: Description
public_page_description.description: Intro text at the top of the public page (at most 300 characters)

push_notifications.label: Push notifications
push_notifications.description: Whether the bot may send web push notifications to staff subscribed on the dashboard (new ticket, leave request, reply in a claimed ticket)

language_per_user.label: Hidden replies in the member's language
language_per_user.description: When on, replies only you can see come in the member's own Discord language (Hungarian / English / German client); public messages stay in the server language

hide_staff_commands.label: Hide staff commands from members
hide_staff_commands.description: Simpler / list: staff and admin commands (e.g. /ban, /purge, /lock) only show for people with the matching Discord permission (Manage Messages / Timeout Members / Manage Server). If a staff member can’t see their command: give them that permission, allow it under Server Settings → Integrations → bot, or turn this off

crime_chance_multiplier.label: Success chance multiplier
crime_chance_multiplier.description: Multiplier on the success chance of every crime, robbery and crew heist (below 1 = harder)

crime_fine_multiplier.label: Fine multiplier
crime_fine_multiplier.description: Multiplier on the fines paid when caught

crime_jail_multiplier.label: Jail multiplier
crime_jail_multiplier.description: Multiplier on the chance and length of jail when caught

underworld_daily_cap.label: Daily loot cap
underworld_daily_cap.description: A member can earn at most this much dirty money per day from crime (grows with underworld rank: ×1 for Rookie, ×6 for Godfather). 0 = no cap

crime_repeat_penalty.label: Repeat penalty
crime_repeat_penalty.description: Each repeat of the same crime on the same day pays this much less (down to 20% at most)

crimes_disabled.label: Disabled crimes
crimes_disabled.description: These crimes can't be chosen on this server

heists_disabled.label: Disabled crew heists
heists_disabled.description: These crew heists can't be started on this server

robbery_approaches_disabled.label: Disabled robbery methods
robbery_approaches_disabled.description: These robbery methods can't be chosen on this server

robbery_daily_limit.label: Robbery: daily attempts
robbery_daily_limit.description: A member can try to rob others at most this many times per day

robbery_max_steal_amount.label: Robbery: max amount
robbery_max_steal_amount.description: At most this much can be taken in one robbery (regardless of the percentage)

robbery_min_victim_cash.label: Robbery: target's minimum cash
robbery_min_victim_cash.description: Only members carrying at least this much cash can be targeted (protects members with little money)

robbery_report_enabled.label: Robbery: reporting
robbery_report_enabled.description: The robbed member can report the robber by DM: if caught, part of the loot is returned and the robber may go to jail

underworld_event_strength.label: Event strength
underworld_event_strength.description: How strongly world events take effect (1 = normal, 2 = twice the effect, 0.5 = half)

underworld_max_events.label: Simultaneous events
underworld_max_events.description: At most this many world events run at the same time

underworld_events_disabled.label: Disabled events
underworld_events_disabled.description: These world events never start on this server

options.orsegvaltas: Changing of the guard at the National Bank

ticket_thread_mode.label: Tickets as threads
ticket_thread_mode.description: New tickets open as private threads in the panel's channel (not as separate channels). This keeps the server's channel-creation limit free — Discord blocks it for hours when exceeded. Off: the old mode, every ticket gets its own channel

ticket_thread_channel.label: Ticket thread channel
ticket_thread_channel.description: Ticket threads open in this channel (empty: where the member pressed the panel button). The bot needs here: create private threads, send messages in threads, manage threads

bank_interest_cap.label: Interest-bearing amount cap
bank_interest_cap.description: Daily interest is paid on at most this much bank balance (anything above earns no interest — so the rich can't run away forever). 0 = no cap

daily_reward_base.label: Daily reward
daily_reward_base.description: The first day's amount of the daily reward (/penz → Daily reward)

daily_reward_step.label: Daily reward: daily increase
daily_reward_step.description: The daily reward grows by this much on every consecutive day

daily_reward_max_streak.label: Daily reward: streak length
daily_reward_max_streak.description: The daily reward streak keeps growing for this many days

stock_news_channel.label: Stock news channel
stock_news_channel.description: A separate channel for breaking market news (takeover, trading halt, crisis …) — the price board channel stays clean; if empty, news only shows on the /tozsde terminal's News tab
stock_news_channel.why: breaking market news only shows in the terminal

quiz_channel.label: Quiz channel
quiz_channel.description: Daily quiz: the bot asks a few times a day (trivia, mental math, scramble, number sequence); the first correct answer wins a reward

quiz_per_day.label: Quiz: questions per day
quiz_per_day.description: On average this many quiz questions per day (between 9:00 and 23:00)

quiz_reward.label: Quiz: money reward
quiz_reward.description: The first correct answer gets this much money

quiz_xp.label: Quiz: XP reward
quiz_xp.description: The first correct answer gets this much XP

mega_events.label: Market crash / golden age
mega_events.description: Rare mega event: market crash or golden age — bitcoin, stocks and the underworld move at once (whichever are on)

mega_event_days.label: Mega event frequency
mega_event_days.description: On average a mega event every this many days (at least half that between two)

mega_event_channel.label: Mega event channel
mega_event_channel.description: The shared banner of the mega event goes here (empty: the crypto, stock or underworld news channel)

bounty_min.label: Bounty: minimum
bounty_min.description: The smallest bounty that can be placed on a member (10% broker fee; whoever robs or busts the target takes it)

clan_season_prize.label: Season prize
clan_season_prize.description: Monthly clan season: at month end the clan with the most points gets this much in its vault (points come from members' activity and territory wars)

clan_season_role.label: Season champion role
clan_season_role.description: Members of the season's champion clan get this role (until the next champion) — empty: no role

wheel_base.label: Lucky wheel: base prize
wheel_base.description: Daily lucky wheel (/penz → Lucky wheel): the base of the money prizes — the wheel pays 1–20× this (0 = off)

community_goal_channel.label: Community goal channel
community_goal_channel.description: Weekly community goal: the server works toward a shared goal (messages, voice minutes, jobs …) with a live image card; if reached, every participant gets a reward

community_goal_reward.label: Community goal: reward
community_goal_reward.description: Every member who contributed to a completed weekly goal gets this much

modmail_channel.label: Modmail channel
modmail_channel.description: Modmail: members can DM the bot and every conversation gets its own thread in this (staff-only) channel

modmail_anonymous.label: Modmail: anonymous replies
modmail_anonymous.description: Modmail replies don't show which staff member wrote them
